description: Starts nwsppr for the person's company with their own work email, once they have asked for it or agreed to it (person_agreed). Nothing is charged: the reply has a message and usually a link (Stripe checkout or sign-in) for the person to open, or says they're on the waitlist.

industry.description: The company's industry: a slug from list_plans, or its name (e.g. 'fintech').

keep_up_with.description: Competitors, products and topics to follow, comma separated.

person_agreed.description: true: the person asked for or agreed to this signup.

plan.description: Plan id from list_plans. There is one plan, daily; add-ons are added later inside the app.

name: start_signup
title: Start a signup for a person
